title: Bouncing DVD Logo
description: Shows a bouncing DVD logo in all gameplay.
body:
This is an incredibly simple mod that displays the [DVD screensaver](https://bouncingdvdlogo.com/) while in game.

## Features
- DVD logo that changes colour on bounce
- ???
- that's all the mod does.

View the source code at [https://github.com/Desyncfy/Bouncing-DVD-Logo-Minecraft](https://github.com/Desyncfy/Bouncing-DVD-Logo-Minecraft).
